paragraphs.text: Define How LAMID ONE Operates in Your Organization.
Set the policies that govern AI, persistent progression, permissions, delegation, capability availability, data, workflows, overrides, and approvals.
Require human review before selected workflows or consequential actions proceed; allow authorized users to pause, redirect, override, or revoke progression before commitment.
Manage organization-level settings, ownership, policy defaults, and delegated administration.
Set policy separately for Observe & Update, Progress Within Authorization, and Consequential Commitment. A lower band must never inherit or infer the permissions of a higher band.
